what: Re-check published articles against the printed margins (TRANSLATING.md, 'Re-checking a published article'). Work in order.

items.note: Re-checked 2026-11-12 (by hand, as the model for later runs). Added 69 reference-only markers from the margin (the margin's numerals were often misread by margins.py: e.g. 'II Reg.' read as 3 Kings, 'Josue ... Ibid.' as Job; each verse was checked against the Latin) and one lemma (1:17 in para 23). No margin note read, kept as quoted word for word (check against the scan, PDF 25-33): Ecclus 24:5, Wis 7:25, Wis 7:26, Gen 15:1, Gen 21:12, Gen 21:6, John 19:17, Luke 2:10, Luke 2:11. Margin notes citing only a chapter are given as verse 1 (Gen 48:1, Gen 49:1). Para 9 has a note where the margin is partly unreadable; para 29 notes III Esdras iv-v (not in this Bible).

Margin references from PDF 32 above the heading belong to Art. I and were left out. Numerals read as: 'Luc. ii, 31' -> Luke 3:31; 'I Par. xvi, 17' -> 1 Par 18:17 (kept tag); 'Prov. iv, 4' -> Prov 4:4; 'Ibid. 17, 18' -> 1 Par 3:17-18; 'Luc. i, 97, 63' -> Luke 1:57, 63; Num 36:6-9 marked at 36:6 and 36:8. Unread note 'II Reg. xi(i), 5' beside Bethsabee's first son (PDF 34) left untagged: 2 Kings 11:5 or 12:15?

Margin notes on PDF 36 R (Art. II) and PDF 41 (Art. IV) left out. Kept tags whose margin notes were misread: Luke 5:8 ('Luc. 9,8'), Is 52:6 ('Is. lii, 6'), Zach 3:9 ('8, 9'), Is 53:2 ('Is. liii, 2'), 2 Kings 20:9, Is 49:1. Added Heb 10:13 beside the 1 Cor 15:25 blend (note updated). Ex 13:2 is a guess for a part-unread 'Ibid. xiii(?)' (PDF 40); Matt 12:46 and 13:55 read from 'Matth. xii, 46; xiii, 55' (OCR 'x', '93'). Exod. xxxiv margin beside Moses' face: only 34:30 marked (the further verse numbers unreadable).

Margin notes on PDF 40 (Art. III) and PDF 46 (Art. V) left out. Reference-only markers from unread or part-read notes: Acts 12:2, 12:4 ('Act. xii, 4-'), Acts 12:23, Dan 9:24 ('ix, 24-'?), Gen 35:19 ('Gen. xxxv, 19'), Is 48:11 ('xlviii, 11'). 1 Esd 2 (chapter only) given as 2:1; a second note beside the Machabees ('II, vii'?, PDF 41 R) left unread. Ex 8:7, 18, 19 (unread '7, 18, 19' after Ex 7:11, 22) not marked. No margin note read for Mich 5:2 in para 12 (Denis's second rendering of Micah) and 1 Cor 3:10, 12 (margin 'I Cor. iii, 10, 12' misread): kept.

Margin notes on PDF 45 (Art. IV) and PDF 50 R-52 (Art. VI) left out. Misread notes kept as the tags' references: John 8:59 ('Joann. viii, 59'), Is 19:1, Ex 4:22-23, 1 Cor 2:8 ('II Cor.'), Num 23:22. 'Reg. xi, 1' beside Solomon hearing his kingdom would be rent read as 3 Kings 11:11 (could be 11:1); 'Gen. xxxvii, 3[3]' as Gen 37:33. Added a Luke 2:28 tag (word for word). Unread 'Exod. vii-xiv' beside the plagues of Egypt (PDF 47 L) left unmarked.

No margin note read (kept, word for word): 1 Cor 10:2, Acts 1:5, Luke 12:50 (para 7); 1 Cor 11:27, Luke 12:49, 2 Tim 3:12 have misread notes beside them. Numerals corrected from the Latin: 'Joann. vii, 33' -> John 8:33 (the Jews boasting of Abraham); 'Ps. xxxiii, 15; xxxvi, 27'; 'Act. xiii, 46'; 'Osee ii, 1, 23'; 'Luc. iii, 15'. 'Lev. xii' (chapter only) given as Lev 12:1. Para 13: margin beside Luke's 'ad turbas' read as 'Luc. xx, 4...'; marked Luke 3:7 (the existing note already says so).

No margin note read (kept, word for word): Ps 17:38, Rom 16:20 (para 20); Ecclus 10:7, Jas 4:6 (also 1 Pet 5:5; Denis names neither), 1 John 3:15 (para 21). Jer 23:6 kept against the margin's apparent 'xxxiii, 16': Denis has 'vocabunt eum' (23:6), not 'eam' (33:16). Margin 'Joann. vii, 45' read as John 8:44 (the devil a liar). Unread note 'iv, 3-9' beside Luke's order of the temptations (PDF 65 L) left unmarked.

No margin note read (kept, word for word): Jer 16:16 (para 7); Ps 14:4, Rom 2:21, Luke 4:23 (para 15); 2 Par 17:7-9 (para 16). Is 9:1-2 and John 5:36 have misread notes beside them. 'Joann. ii-iv' (chapters only) given as John 2:1 and 4:1; 'Joann. ii(?), 1-11' beside 'many believed in Him' read as John 2:11 (Cana). Unread 'xxxiv, 14, 15' beside the tribes beyond the Jordan taken as Num 34:14-15 (book name unread, PDF 70 L).

PDF 74 R seems to have no margin notes read at all: tags there kept unconfirmed (Ps 118:136, Rom 7:24, Ps 41:4, Ps 119:5, Ps 76:3, Eccles 2:2, Ps 93:19, Rom 8:17, Tob 3:22); the mourning of Samuel, Jeremias and Daniel there is unmarked. Also no note read for 1 Cor 15:46 (para 5); Gal 6:3, Ps 33:19, Phil 3:8 (para 6); Prov 11:2 (para 10); Ps 83:3 (unread 'Ps. lxxxiii, 3'), 2 Cor 4:17 (misread 'II Cor. iv, 17'). Para 21: 'Pax vobis' retagged from Luke 24:36 to John 20:19 (margin 'Joann. xx, 19, 21, 26'). Margin 'Ps. xxxiii, 9' beside 'gustare quam dulcis' marked as Ps 33:9.

No margin note read (kept, word for word): Gen 45:24 (para 16), Rom 1:9 and 1 Tim 5:21 (para 36), Jer 4:2 (para 37); Rom 2:24, 1 Par 29:14, Ps 118:37, 1 Cor 7:10-11, 2 Cor 1:23 have misread/unread notes beside them. Para 5: retagged Ecclus 41:17 -> 20:32 per the margin (same words; note added). Para 10: margin 'Marc. ii, 11' beside the bed carried on the sabbath (that healing is John 5:8-10; note added). Para 30: margin 'Exod. xx, 17' beside Denis's words of Deut 5:21 (both marked, note added). 'You have defiled My holy name' marked Ezech 36:20 and 43:8 from a part-unread note ('22; xliii, 8'?, PDF 81).

Every remaining tag without a read margin note has an unread note beside it (Rom 12:21, 2 Esd 4:5, Is 40:18, 25, Ps 7:10, 1 Kings 16:7). Para 13: margin 'Rom. xii, 20' beside the words Denis gives as Solomon's: Prov 25:21 tag kept, Rom 12:20 added as reference. Lev 19:2, 20:7, 20:26, 21:8 added after the Lev 11:44 tag (margin 'xi, 43-45; xix, 2; xx, 7, 26; xxi, 8').

All tags now have a margin note beside them (some misread: 1 Tim 2:8, Is 56:7 'Is. lvi, 7', Tob 12:12). Ps 28:2 added beside the Ps 95:9 tag (same words; margin gives both); 'cxxxiv, 17' read as Ps 134:17 beside 'have ears and hear not'.

Tags without a read note all have an unread/misread note beside them, except Luke 11:3 repeated in para 12 (kept). Para 1: unread 'Is. x, 23' beside the 'verbum abbrevians' quotation, which Denis gives in St Paul's form (Rom 9:28 tag kept, Is 10:23 added). 'Rom. v, 11' beside 'no respect of persons' read as Rom 2:11. 'Exod. vii, ix-xiv' (hardening Pharao) given as Ex 7:1 (chapter only).

No margin note read (kept): 1 Cor 7:32 (para 20). Para 5: margin 'Coloss. iii, 5' beside 'idolorum servitus', which are Eph 5:5's words (Eph tag kept, Col 3:5 added, note). Para 20: retagged Jos 22:27 -> 22:24 per the margin; Denis's words are 22:24's, so the old note about a missing negative was dropped. Two '[cf. …]' notes turned into reference markers (Ecclus 34:23, Heb 11:13). The margin notes on 1 Cor 2:15 / 11:31 (PDF 104?) seem to belong to Art. XV.
